WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A FAST - GROWING ORGANISATION? 
JOIN US AS COOK AT HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS ALMERE.ABOUT HOLIDAY INN EXPRESSAt Holiday Inn Express® hotels we keep it simple and smart. As IHG's biggest hotel brand, we're first choice for the increasing number of travelers who need a simple, engaging place to rest, recharge and get a little work done. We offer everything guests need and provide more where it matters most.THE POSITIONAs a Cook, you will take on a high level of responsibility, ensuring our guests start their day with a great breakfast experience. Our hotel has 160 rooms, breakfast is included for every guest, and we daily serve group lunches and dinners. The ideal candidate is a great organizer, works in a fast pace and is a real team player. You work closely with the F&B team and report to the Operations Manager.This is a position for 15.2 hours on a weekly basis. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Prepare and maintain the breakfast buffet with hot and cold dishes 
• Prepare group lunch and dinner
• Monitor food quality, freshness and hygiene standards (HACCP)
• Maintain a clean and organized kitchen
• Daily ordering of supplies with different suppliers
• Collaborating with other departments to ensure smooth running of the kitchenWHAT YOU'LL BRING 
• Being able to work independently in the kitchen
• Having a creative and warm personality and knowing how to connect with everyone.
• Guest-oriented and representative.
• Speaking excellent English, the Dutch language is a plus.
• Experience in hotel settings is a plus.
